# Documentation templates

Copy a template to the relevant folder and give the copy a dated, descriptive filename. Replace its placeholder title/date and status. These files work as ordinary notes; no plugin is required.

- [Decision](Decision.md): accepted behavior, options and consequences.
- [Review](Review.md): scope, findings, reproduction and evidence.
- [Change](Change.md): delivered behavior, files, deployment and checks.
- [Session handover](Session-Handover.md): completed work, current context and next steps.

Link the new note from [Current state](../project/Current-State.md) or its relevant system page, then refresh the [catalog](../reference/Document-Catalog.md).
